ZinModules.ModuleIdentity: Each source file is a module namespace.
ZinModules.GlobalInitialization: Global const and var initializers must be comptime evaluable. There are no hidden runtime global constructors.
ZinModules.Destructors: There are no implicit destructors. Use defer/deinit explicitly.
ZinModules.CircularImports: Allowed only if declaration resolution does not require cyclic CTFE evaluation.
